text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock merely because it is above my average cost; decisions should reflect its future risk and role in my portfolio.","My earlier gain-taking and later repurchases show how anchoring on cost and avoiding the pain of losses can distort decisions. I should use consistent, forward-looking rules for both winners and losers.","With prices moving randomly and my trades infrequent, I should avoid reacting to short-term swings, maintain diversification, and trade only when my plan or risk needs justify it."]}
